probe: SELECT @@version_comment AS product, VERSION() AS version, DATABASE() AS catalog

queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA AS `schema`,TABLE_NAME AS name,ENGINE AS engine FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=%s AND TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA AS `schema`,TABLE_NAME AS name,COLUMN_NAME AS column_name,COLUMN_TYPE AS data_type,ORDINAL_POSITION AS ordinal,IS_NULLABLE AS nullable FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=%s AND TABLE_NAME IN (SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.TABLES t WHERE t.TABLE_SCHEMA=COLUMNS.TABLE_SCHEMA AND t.TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

SELECT c.TABLE_SCHEMA AS `schema`,c.TABLE_NAME AS name,c.CONSTRAINT_NAME AS constraint_name,CASE c.CONSTRAINT_TYPE WHEN 'PRIMARY KEY' THEN 'primary_key' WHEN 'FOREIGN KEY' THEN 'foreign_key' WHEN 'UNIQUE' THEN 'unique' WHEN 'CHECK' THEN 'check' END AS constraint_kind,k.COLUMN_NAME AS column_name,k.REFERENCED_TABLE_SCHEMA AS ref_schema,k.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME AS ref_table,k.REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME AS ref_column FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS c LEFT JOIN information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k ON k.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=c.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND k.TABLE_NAME=c.TABLE_NAME AND k.CONSTRAINT_NAME=c.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE c.TABLE_SCHEMA=%s ORDER BY c.TABLE_NAME,c.CONSTRAINT_NAME,k.ORDINAL_POSITION

SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA AS `schema`,CONCAT(TABLE_NAME,'.',INDEX_NAME) AS name,TABLE_NAME AS table_name,COLUMN_NAME AS column_name,(NON_UNIQUE=0) AS is_unique FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=%s ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA AS `schema`,TABLE_NAME AS name FROM information_schema.VIEWS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=%s ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
SELECT LOWER(ROUTINE_TYPE) AS object_kind,ROUTINE_SCHEMA AS `schema`,ROUTINE_NAME AS name FROM information_schema.ROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA=%s ORDER BY ROUTINE_NAME
SELECT TRIGGER_SCHEMA AS `schema`,TRIGGER_NAME AS name FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA=%s ORDER BY TRIGGER_NAME
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA AS `schema`,TABLE_NAME AS name,TABLE_ROWS AS value FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=%s AND TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE'
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA AS `schema`,TABLE_NAME AS name,DATA_LENGTH+INDEX_LENGTH AS value FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=%s AND TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE'

SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA AS `schema`,CONCAT(OBJECT_NAME,'.',INDEX_NAME) AS name,COUNT_READ AS value,(@@performance_schema AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM performance_schema.setup_instruments WHERE NAME='wait/io/table/sql/handler' AND ENABLED='YES')) AS enabled FROM performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_index_usage WHERE OBJECT_SCHEMA=%s AND INDEX_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY OBJECT_NAME,INDEX_NAME
